subject: OpenGrid production: modelpack v5 deploy causing latency & error surge
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@opengridlabs.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: OpenGrid SRE <sre@opengridlabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: major p95/p99 latency increase and 5xxs after v5 modelpack deploy

Diego —

We pushed Redwood modelpack v5 this morning (can share trace IDs) and immediately saw p95 jump from ~210ms to ~1.2s and a spike of ~6% 5xxs for our high-throughput inference route. This is impacting our realtime scoring pipeline and causing downstream backpressure. We've attached a perf snapshot and some traces.

Can someone triage urgently? Our CS and SRE teams are seeing a steady error rate and customers are being rate-limited. This rollout was on the 07:00 PDT window.

Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of ML Ops, OpenGrid Labs
attachments: perf_snapshot_20261104.zip; error_traces_oglog.txt

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@opengridlabs.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: major p95/p99 latency increase and 5xxs after v5 modelpack deploy

Aisha — thanks for the heads up and for the traces. I'm escalating this to the on-call infra and our model team immediately. Initial ask: can you confirm the traffic mix (percentage of long-context prompts) and whether you enabled the new int8 quant profile? That will help narrow fast.

Planned immediate actions from Redwood:
- Triage logs + compare kernel selection between v4 and v5 (Marcus)
- Isolate request traces hitting >1s and capture KV cache behavior (Irene)
- Prepare a fallback play to pin back to v4 if needed (Vanessa / Diego)

We'll update within 60 minutes with a recommended mitigation and ETA for a rollback if required. Sorry for the disruption — getting this to exec attention now.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
AMER Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@opengridlabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: major p95/p99 latency increase and 5xxs after v5 modelpack deploy

On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 09:28 AM Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Aisha — thanks for the heads up and for the traces. I'm escalating this to the on-call infra and our model team immediately.

I pulled a few sample traces — two quick notes:
1) v5's default kernel selector is choosing a mixed-float path when it sees the "compact-int8" profile enabled on some requests. The fallback scheduling is not always matching the v4 behavior, so we've got inconsistent kernel latency.
2) There's a clear traffic pattern with ~22% of requests using long contexts (>1024 tokens) which coupled with the mixed kernel selection is amplifying queuing.

Immediate mitigations I'm pushing now:
- Lock requests from OpenGrid to a v5-compatible float path (temporary) to eliminate mixed execution variance.
- If latency doesn't come down in 20m, execute a rollback to modelpack v4 (we have pins ready).

I'll post logs and a short kernel-choice diff to the Jira. Marcus, can you run a quick quant-profile replay to confirm the perf delta?

— Irene
Irene Choi, Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@opengridlabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: major p95/p99 latency increase and 5xxs after v5 modelpack deploy

Folks — quick replay results attached to the Ops ticket (OPS-9821). Short summary:
- v5 with the "compact-int8" profile shows better median cost but exhibits a long tail on certain attention kernels (observed when sequence length > 768). The long-tail correlates with the 5xxs (OOM/retry behavior under sustained bursts).
- Replaying v5 traffic through the v4 execution path drops p95 by ~600ms in our repro.

Recommendation (immediate):
1) Toggle OpenGrid route to the v5 float-fallback path (Irene is doing this now).
2) If stable within 20m, proceed with a staged safety patch to runtime kernel selector to avoid mixed-float selection for compact-int8 for workloads with >512 median seq length.
3) If instability persists, roll back to v4 for OpenGrid and schedule a postmortem with the modelpack owners.

I'm also preparing a short note for the leadership bridge with the perf numbers. Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: (see OPS-9821)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@opengridlabs.com>, ceo@redwood.ai, cto@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-05T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OpenGrid production: modelpack v5 deploy causing latency & error surge

Team — quick executive summary for visibility:

What happened: Modelpack v5 introduced a new default quantization path (compact-int8) and a kernel-selection heuristic that, under OpenGrid's traffic mix (notably ~22% long-context calls), produced high tail latency and transient 5xxs leading to backpressure.

Actions taken:
- Rolled OpenGrid to a v5 float-fallback path at 10:15 PDT on 2026-11-04 — p95 improved but not fully back to baseline.
- Given risk to SLAs, rolled back OpenGrid to modelpack v4 at 11:05 PDT and restored stable p95.
- Filed OPS-9821 and attached perf snapshots and traces; assigned postmortem to modelpack owners and runtime team.

Customer impact: Production scoring pipeline experienced degraded latency for ~4h; no data loss but several request retries and temporary rate limiting. OpenGrid leadership was briefed and accepted rollback; they requested a short postmortem and mitigation timeline.

Next steps / asks:
- Model team: add a non-mixed path test in CI for compact-int8 under >512 median-length workloads.
- Runtime team: add a conservative guard in the kernel selector for customer routes with >15% long-context traffic.
- Sales/CS (Diego): coordinate a customer-facing postmortem + proposed timeline within 72 hours.

I'll be on the bridge at 17:00 to answer exec questions; Diego, please prepare the customer note draft.

— Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
